title: Covariant commutators preserve the combined derivative--charge filtration

covariant_filtration.operators: D_mu=partial_mu+i A_mu Q on the K1359 common core; [Q,D_mu]=0 and [D_mu,D_nu]=i F_mu_nu Q
covariant_filtration.basic_wave_commutator: [D_a,D^mu D_mu]u=i(partial^mu F_(a mu))Q u+2i F_a^mu Q D_mu u
covariant_filtration.iterated_form: [D^alpha,D^mu D_mu]Q^n phi is a finite sum of (partial^beta F) D^gamma Q^(n+1)phi with |beta|+|gamma|<=|alpha|
covariant_filtration.combined_order: Every matter factor has |gamma|+(n+1)<=|alpha|+n+1, exactly the principal derivative/charge tier already present in the energy of D^alpha Q^n phi
covariant_filtration.curvature_order: The coefficient factor uses at most |alpha| ordinary derivatives of F and creates no independent rectangular corner
covariant_filtration.mechanism: One covariant-derivative commutator trades derivative position for one Q through curvature; total derivative-plus-charge order is triangular rather than rectangular
covariant_filtration.boundary: The identity is algebraic on the smooth K-finite common core; it is not a null-form cancellation, a global estimate or source ownership of Q
